name: coolify
description: Connect Cursor and Grok Bot to your Coolify instance. List apps, servers, deploys, and logs through Coolify's official MCP endpoint.

COOLIFY_URL.title: Coolify URL
COOLIFY_URL.description: Your Coolify instance URL with no trailing slash, e.g. https://coolify.example.com or https://app.coolify.io

COOLIFY_TOKEN.title: Coolify API token
COOLIFY_TOKEN.description: Team-scoped API token from Coolify Keys & Tokens. MCP must be enabled on the instance.
